intro.title: Cambridge Hospital
intro.subtitle: Personalised Care, Every Step of the Way
text: Cambridge Hospital provides comprehensive and specialised post-acute, rehabilitation and long-term care for patients recovering from illness, injury or complex medical conditions, as well as those requiring ongoing support.

Our multidisciplinary teams deliver personalised care based on each patient’s needs, helping them recover, regain independence and improve their quality of life. We work closely with families throughout the journey, providing guidance and support as patients transition between different stages of care.

title: Cambridge Group Establishment
items.text: The holding company was established to develop long-term care facilities across the region.

title: UAE – Abu Dhabi and Al Ain Facilities Launch
items.text: Phase I in Abu Dhabi Hospital launched in June 2014, followed by Phase II in January 2015 and the Al Ain facility in April 2015.

title: UAE - TVU Programme Launch
items.text: Launched the first Transitional Vent Unit (TVU) programme for mechanically ventilated patients.

title: UAE & KSA Expansion
items.text: Secured a SAGIA license for expansion into Saudi Arabia and opened Phase II of Al Ain Facility.

title: KSA - Dhahran Facility Launch
items.text: Opened the Eastern Province’s first dedicated inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation facility.

title: UAE - Abu Dhabi Facility Expansion
items.text: Expanded the Abu Dhabi facility, with capacity planned to reach 106 beds.

title: Group Acquisition by Amanat
items.text: Strategic acquisition by Amanat Holdings to drive accelerated sustainable growth.

title: KSA - IECC Jeddah Acquisition
items.text: Group acquired a majority stake in the IECC facility in Jeddah, adding 100 beds to the group’s portfolio.

title: UAE - Al Ain Facility Expansion
items.text: Expanded the Al Ain facility to a capacity of 109 beds.

title: UAE - Al Mudeef Centre Partnership
items.text: Entered into a public-private partnership with Zayed Higher Organisation to operate and maintain the 80-bed Al Mudeef facility.

title: KSA - Al Khobar Facility Commissioning
items.text: Commissioned a long-term care and ICU facility in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province.

title: KSA - Al Khobar Facility Expansion
items.text: Licensed 100 additional beds, including 30 rehabilitation beds, bringing total capacity to 200 beds.

title: Cambridge Health Group Launch
items.text: Established Cambridge Health Group as the regional healthcare platform for strategic growth and portfolio expansion.

title: KSA - Al Khobar Facility Expansion
items.text: Increased the Al Khobar facility’s capacity to 150 beds as part of the group’s expansion in Saudi Arabia.

title: Full Ownership by Amanat
items.text: Amanat Holdings acquired full ownership of Cambridge Health Group, supporting further growth and integration.

title: Cambridge Hospital Brand Unification
items.text: CMRE, Al Mudeef Center and IECC facilities in the UAE and Saudi Arabia unified under the Cambridge Hospital brand.

title: KSA - Cambridge Home Care Launch
items.text: Launched Cambridge Home Care in Saudi Arabia, providing initial home-based patient services.
